title: jams engine sound, format v1

$schema.description: The sound JSON Schema this file follows.

bus.description: The bus it plays through: master, music, sfx, voice, ui; a game adds its own in GameDefinition.audio.buses.

pitch.description: Playback rate picked per play, [min, max]; 1 is the clip's own pitch. Default [1, 1].

clip.description: An audio clip or a synth patch.

weight.description: How often it's picked against the others; default 1.

items.description: One clip the sound may play.

variants.description: The clips it picks from on each play, by weight; none plays nothing.

cooldownMs.description: A second play inside this many ms of wall time is dropped.
cooldownMs.title: Cooldown

maxVoices.description: At most this many playing at once, the oldest stopped; default 8.

positional.description: Pan from where it plays against the main view; default false.

range.description: A positional sound fades out linearly over this distance; omitted, no falloff.

caption.description: A string key shown as a caption when it plays.

on.description: The step events that play it.

event.description: A step event type: "contact:start", "anim:frame", a game's own.

type.description: Only when the event's entity is of this type.

tag.description: Only when the event's entity carries this tag.

data.description: Only when the event's data equals each of these keys (shallow).

items.description: A step event that plays the sound.

preload.description: Load its clips with the scene bundle instead of on first play; default false.

description: One sound: its bus, volume, pitch range and variants, and the step events that play it. Presentation only.
